critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 867 lines and still mixes 6+ concerns (cleaners, assignments, app-images, site-images, settings, sheets, sms). The Job Assignments section (~lines 765-840) is a clean, self-contained slice that would be trivial to extract to /app/backend/routes/assignments.py — carry-over from iter 7/8 recommendation.

backend/server.py:790 create_assignment — the delete_many({'quote_id': ...}) then insert_one is 2 sequential ops without a transaction. In practice fine (single writer, tolerable race), but under concurrent admin re-assigns of the same quote you could theoretically get 0 or 2 rows momentarily. Consider replace_one(..., upsert=True) with a unique index on quote_id, OR just document the invariant. Not a bug today.

backend/server.py:766 AssignmentCreate has no length validators on customer_name/address/message — a malicious admin could store multi-KB junk. Low priority (admin-gated), but Pydantic Field(max_length=...) would harden it.

frontend admin.js:194 onAssignPick — success path does not clear stale `error` state from a previous failed assign, so a leftover red banner can persist after a subsequent successful assign. One-line fix: setError('') at start of onAssignPick / onUnassign.

frontend cleaner.js:40 60s poll interval is fine, but fetchCleanerJobs errors are only console.warn'd — a stale 401 (PIN changed while polling) will silently keep the last jobs on screen forever. Consider clearing jobs + surfacing 'Please sign out and check in again' when e.code === 401 (mirrors sendCleanerLocation handling on line 80).

frontend CleanerPicker.js:20 .catch(() => setCleaners([])) swallows the error message — user just sees empty list. Consider surfacing a small inline error so admin can tell 'no cleaners exist' from 'network failed'.

frontend TeamMap.js:16 require('leaflet') inside useEffect works but bundles leaflet into the main chunk. Consider dynamic import() so leaflet only ships when the admin actually opens the Map view — perf-only, not a bug.

frontend TeamMap.js:44 fitBounds is called on every effect run — when only 1 point exists, this zooms the map to maxZoom=14 which is fine, but on subsequent 60s cleaner refreshes the map re-centers/re-zooms even if nothing moved. Consider skipping fitBounds when the cleaner set didn't change, or only on first render.

admin.js:113 assignments state is a { quote_id -> assignment } map — safe today because backend enforces 1-per-quote via delete_many, but if that invariant ever loosens (e.g., multi-cleaner assign), the frontend map would silently drop assignments. Consider storing an array and derive 'is assigned' via .find().

console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' fires from TeamMap.js overlay — swap `pointerEvents="none"` prop for style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} to silence a runtime deprecation warning in React Native Web.
